note: Header sections sized against MaxHeaderSize, 128 KB. The three fixtures are the multi key document padded out with pad-NNNNN headers to an exact section size: 64 bytes under the limit, 4096 bytes under it, and exactly at it, which is refused because the reader compares with >=. The cheapest signature that can be appended is an Ed25519 line at 108 bytes, a 20 character fingerprint, a colon, 86 characters of base64 and a newline, so 64 bytes has no room for one and 4096 does. ed25519_2 signed none of these documents, so re-signing adds a line rather than replacing one, which is what makes the room and overflow cases differ. The expected outputs here are large because the header sections are, and matching them whole is what proves no pad header was silently dropped.

cases.note: The new signature landed and every pad header round tripped through the header map, so nothing was silently dropped.
